title: Digital Arrest Threat — CBI Officer Impersonation

evidence_items.original_text: Main CBI officer Rajesh Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar card par illegal parcel Mumbai customs ne pakda hai. Is parcel mein drugs aur money laundering ke documents hain. Agar aap turant arrest warrant se bachna chahte hain to apni verification deposit 50000 rupees verify-cbi@okhdfcbank par transfer kijiye. Kisi ko mat batana, aap video call surveillance par hain.
